senses.gloss:
पिश् 1. पिश्, cl. 6. P. A. पिंशति, -ते,
पिपेश, पिपिशे, पेशिष्यति, -ते, अपेशीत्,
पेशितुम्, Ved. to adorn, deck, decorate, embellish;
to prepare, make ready (especially meat, by cutting
it up and carving it); to shape, fashion, mould,
form; to be decomposed, to be reduced to consti-
tuent parts; to be organized; to light, enlighten:
Caus. पेशयति, Aor. अपीपिशत्: Desid. पिपिशिषति,
पिपेशिषति; Intens. पेपिश्यते, पेपेष्टि, to be
richly adorned.

2. पिश्, f. an ornament, decoration; (Sāy.) =
रूपं हिरण्यादि.

पिष् पिष्, cl. 7. P. (ep. also A.) पिनष्टि,
पिंष्टे (Impv. 2nd sing. पिण्ढि), पि-
पेष, पेक्ष्यति, अपिषत्, पेष्टुम् (ep. Impf.
अपिंषत्, Pot. पिषेत्), to grind, pound, crush; to
bruise, hurt, injure, destroy; cl. 10. P. or Caus. पेष-
यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अपीपिषत्, to grind, pound; to
injure; to give; to be strong; to dwell; cl. 1. 10.
P. पेषति, पेषयति, to go, move; [cf. Gr. πτίσσ-ω
for πίσσ-ω, πίτυρον, πτίσ-μα, πίσ-ο-ς, πίσ-ινο-ς,
πίσσο-; Lat. pins-o, pīs-o, pis-tor, pis-tillu-m,
pistrīnum, pis-tura, pis-u-m, Piso, pī-lu-m,
pī-la, pī-lu-s; Lith. pes-tà, ‘a mill.’]

पिस् पिस्, cl. 4. P. पिस्यति, पेसितुम्, Ved.
to go; (perhaps) to extend; cl. 1. P.
पेसति, पेसितुम्, to go, move; cl. 10. P. पेसयति,
यितुम्, to go; to hurt, injure; to be strong; to
give; to take; to dwell; [cf. rts. पेस्, विस्, वेस्,
बिश्, बेश्.]

पिश, अस्, m., Ved. (according to Sāy.) = रुरु, a
sort of deer (probably so called from its colour).

पिशङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम्, reddish, reddish-brown, of a
tawny or brown colour; (अस्), m. tawny colour; N.
of a serpent-demon.
—पिशङ्ग-ता, f. or पिशङ्ग-
त्व, अम्, n. the being of a tawny colour, tawniness.
—पिशङ्ग-भृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (perhaps) having
red fangs; (Sāy.) = ईषद्-रक्त-वर्ण, being of a
pale-red hue, tawny-coloured.
—पिशङ्ग-राति, इस्,
इस्, इ, Ved. giving reddish (i. e. golden) gifts (said of
Indra); (Sāy.) = बहुरूप-धनेन्द्र, lord of
manifold wealth.
—पिशङ्ग-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
being of a reddish or yellow appearance; (Sāy.) =
हिरण्य-रूप, golden-coloured.
—पिशङ्ग-सन्-
दृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) being
of a red or yellow colour; (according to Sāy.) =
नाना-रूप, of various kinds.
—पिशङ्गाश्व (˚ग-
अश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having reddish or tawny
horses (said of the Maruts).
पिशङ्गक, अस्, m., N. of an attendant of Viṣṇu.
पिशङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, brown, tawny.

पिशङ्गिल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., N. of a colour (?);
(according to Mahī-dhara) = पिशं + गिल.

पिशाच, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. पिश for पिशित,
‘flesh,’ and rt. 1. अञ्च्), N. of a class of demons
(perhaps originally a personification of the ignis
fatuus; in the Veda they are enumerated after gods,
men, Manes, Asuras, and Rākṣasas; in later times
[]
they are described as the children of Krodhā); a
sprite, fiend, goblin, ogre, malevolent being (some-
thing between an infernal imp and a ghost, always
described as fierce and malignant); N. of a Rakṣas;
(ई), f. a female imp, a she-demon [cf. स्त्री-प्˚]; N.
of a daughter of Dakṣa and mother of the Piśācas;
a species of Valeriana (= गन्ध-मांसी).
—पिशाच-
ता, f. or पिशाच-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition
of a Piśāca.
—पिशाच-द्रु, उस्, m. a species of tree,
Trophis Aspera (the favourite haunt of the Piśācas).
—पिशाच-बाधा, f. demoniacal possession.
—पि-
शाच-भाषा, f. ‘Piśāca language,’ a gibberish or cor-
ruption of Sanskrit used in plays.
—पिशाच-मोचन,
अम्, n. ‘release of the Piśāca,’ N. of a place of pilgrim-
age.
—पिशाचमोचन-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place
of pilgrimage.
—पिशाच-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a species of
tree, Trophis Aspera (= शाखोट).
—पिशाच-सञ्-
चार, अस्, m. demoniacal possession.
—पिशाच-सभ,
अम्, n. an assemblage of goblins or fiends; the place
or hall of their assembly, pandemonium.
—पिशाचा-
लय (˚च-आल्˚), अस्, m. ‘abode of Piśācas,’ N. of a
particular luminous phenomenon, phosphorescence.
—पिशाची-करण, अम्, n. transforming into a
Piśāca.
—पिशाचोरग-राक्षस (˚च-उर्˚), आस्, m.
pl. Piśācas, serpents, and Rākṣasas.

पिशाचक, अस्, m. a Piśāca; (इका), f. = पिशाची
(at the end of comps., e. g. गन्ध-प्˚, धन-प्˚);
N. of a river; scil. भाषा, the language of the Piśā-
cas.
—पिशाचक-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a village.

पिशाचकिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Kuvera the god
of wealth (the treasures of this deity being guarded
by Piśācas and other malignant beings).
पिशाचि, इस्, m., Ved. a Piśāca.

पिशित, अम्, n. flesh which has been cut up or
prepared, flesh, meat; a small piece; (आ), f. spikenard,
Nardostachys Jatamansi (= जटा-मांसी).
—पिशित-
भुज्, क्, क्, क्, eating flesh; (क्), m. one who eats
flesh.
—पिशिताश (˚त-आश), अस्, आ, अम्, eating flesh;
(अस्), m. an epithet of flesh-eating demons, as Rāk-
ṣasas or Piśācas; a fiend; a cannibal.
—पिशिताशन
(˚त-अश्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, flesh-eating, meat-eating; (अस्),
m. a demon, fiend, cannibal, Rakṣas, Piśāca (de-
scribed as a child of Ni-kaṣā); epithet of a wolf.
—पिशिताशिन् (˚त-आश्˚), ई, इनी, इ, eating flesh or
meat, carnivorous; (ई), m. a demon, goblin, can-
nibal; N. of an attendant of Śiva.
—पिशितेप्सु
(˚त-ईप्˚), उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of flesh, eager for or
greedy after meat.

पिशी, f. spikenard, Nardostachys Jatamansi (=
पिशिता).

पिशुन, अस्, आ, अम्, informing against, betraying,
treacherous; disparaging, calumniating, backbiting,
calumnious, slanderous; cruel, wicked, malignant,
mischievous, harsh, unkind; exciting hopes and dis-
appointing them; vile, low, contemptible, infamous;
stupid, a fool; making known, indicating, evincing,
displaying, reminding, commemorating, memorable
for (at the end of comps., e. g. तुल्यानुराग-प्˚,
manifesting an equal attachment; क्षत्र-प्रध-
न-प्˚, memorable for the conflict of Kṣatriyas);
(अस्), m. a betrayer, traitor, informer, spy, tale-
bearer, backbiter, calumniator, slanderer; epithet of
a goblin dangerous to pregnant women; cotton
(which betrays by hanging to the clothes); an epi-
thet of Nārada (the messenger and informant of the
gods); a crow; N. of a Brāhman; N. of a minister
of Dushyanta; (आ), f. a species of plant, Medicago
Esculenta; (अम्), n. informing against, betraying,
sycophancy; saffron (which betrays an unfaithful
lover); [cf. Gr. πικ῏πό-ς, πευκεδανό-ς, πευκάλιμο-ς,
ἐχε-πευκές: Lith. pī1k-ta-s, ‘bad;’ pýk-ti, ‘to be
angry;’ peīk-ti, ‘to despise, to blame.’]
—पिशुन-
ता, f. slander, scandal, backbiting, betrayal, syco-
phancy.
—पिशुन-वचन or पिशुन-वाक्य, अम्,
n. evil speech, bad report, detraction, slander.
पिशुन पिशुन. See col. 2.

पिशुनय, Nom. P. पिशुनयति, -यितुम्, to
betray, make known, indicate, make manifest.

पिशिक पिशिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people
in the South.

पिशील पिशील or पिशीलक, अम्, n., Ved.
[]
(a wooden) vessel or dish.
—पिशील-वीणा, f. a kind
of stringed instrument or guitar, the strings of which
are stretched across a frame (= शूर्प-वीणा).

पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ground, pounded, crushed,
bruised; rubbed together, squeezed, clasped (as the
hands); kneaded; (अम्), n. anything ground, any
finely ground substance, flour, meal, (न पिष्टम्
पिनष्टि, he does not grind flour, i. e. he does
no useless work or vain repetition); lead; (अस्),
m. pastry; N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his
descendants.
—पिष्ट-पचन, अम्, n. a pan for
parching flower; a boiler, seether, sauce-pan.
—पिष्ट-पशु, उस्, m. an effigy of a beast or
sacrificial victim made with flour or dough.
—पिष्ट-
पाक, अस्, m. food prepared by baking flour.
—पिष्-
टपाक-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, containing food prepared by
baking flour; (त्), m. a boiler.
—पिष्ट-पाचक,
अम्, n. a boiler.
—पिष्ट-पिण्ड, अस्, m. a cake of
meal.
—पिष्ट-पूर, अस्, m. meal made up into a
sort of cake with clarified butter; [cf. घृत-पूर.]
—पिष्ट-पेष, अस्, m. or पिष्ट-पेषण, अम्,
n. ‘grinding flour,’ useless labour, vain repetition.
—पिष्ट-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of meal or flour,
mixed with flour; जलम् पिष्ट-मयम्, water
sprinkled with meal.
—पिष्ट-मेह, अस्, m. flour-
like diabetes.
—पिष्टमेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering
from flour-like diabetes.
—पिष्ट-रस, अस्, m. water
mixed with flour.
—पिष्ट-वर्ति, a small cake made
of the meal of barley, rice, or pulse.
—पिष्ट-
सौरभ, अम्, n. (pulverized) sandal-wood.
—पिष्-
टाद (˚ट-अद), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding on meal.
—पिष्टोदक (˚ट-उद्˚), अम्, n. water mixed with
flour.

पिष्टक, अस्, m. a cake made of the flour or
meal of any grain, any baked cake, bread; a disease
of the eyes, opacity of the cornea; (इका), f. a kind
of grits, the meal of pulse steeped in water and
peeled and ground; (अम्), n. pounded sesamum
seeds, oil-cake.

पिष्टात, अस्, m. perfumed powder (for scenting
rooms, garments, &c.); scented dust which the
Hindūs sprinkle over each other at the Holi or
spring festival.
पिष्टिक, अम्, n. a cake made of rice flour.
पिष्टोडी, f. a species of shrub (= श्वेताम्लि).

पिष्टप पिष्टप, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be
fr. पिश्, substituted for rt. विश्), a world, a division of
the universe; [cf. विष्टप.]

पिस्पृक्षु पिस्पृक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of
rt. स्पृश्), being about to touch; (with जलम्) being
about to enter the water, being about to perform
ablutions.

पिशङ्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, made brown or red, em-
browned, reddened.
